  1 & \text{if } n \text{ is even} \\

- For $ n = 6 \cdot 2^k - 1 $, the value is:
  $$
  a(n) =

  6 & \text{if } k = 0 \text{ or } k = 1 \\
  a(6 \cdot 2^{k-1} - 1) \cdot 2^k & \text{if } k \geq 2
  \end{cases}
  $$

This recursive definition captures the observed behavior and allows for the computation of further terms in the sequence.
